error[ZBX-E0105]: uid and gid mapping is not set up
  cause  alice (uid 1000); newuidmap is neither setuid root nor has a usable
         file capability
  fix    make the helpers setuid root:   sudo chown root: $(command -v newuidmap newgidmap) && sudo chmod u+s $(command -v newuidmap newgidmap)
  more   zbx explain E0105 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0105.html
